qualification: Read-only finalized token-account owner enumeration for eight DAO Wallet PDAs whose State accounts were closed and redemption-started in the earlier cross-slot snapshot. State bytes were rechecked, but wallet token balances/delegations could change between per-wallet RPC calls or afterward. This does not enumerate native SOL delegations, unknown future assets, off-chain cosigner policy or authority roles where the wallet is not token-account owner.
